notes.content:
[b]Merry Christmas, everyone!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999521/8be4697196e1a4c4bb19885b0b0bebd75e69c7c8.png[/img]
[b]
It is here, the update everybody has been waiting for - THE CHRISTMAS UPDATE![/b]

[i]The Blue Land has been repainted white by the snow![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999521/c125749140c8f7372033bd9d905be900b5891cae.png[/img]

Along with the seasonal theme, Blue Land has received a series of patches, including improved player movement, a loading bar, improved game scene unloading, fixing the common crashing while returning to the main menu, and the removal of lag during the "Rain Cloud" Elemental King attack!

notes.title: 1.5 UPDATE
notes.content:
In this new exciting update, Blue Land went through a polishing stage, with massive improvements to the UI. Also, it has received a new game mode - Tutorial, which is meant to help new players understand what to do in this game. Also, a few crafting recipes have been modified to better balance the game, making some weapons harder and some easier to craft.

A major, visible difference from the last update will be the new UI changes, giving this game a completely new look, meant to make the game feel smoother than ever for the player.

[i]Updated UI in the Main [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999521/3193b78a3be57f16a808c67849e60d70ab1e7ac6.png[/img]

Also, the game now has a day and night light cycle, as it made no sense how the night was as bright as the day. The enemies will deal very slightly more damage in the night as well, as a way to further include the day and night cycle into the gameplay in Blue Land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999521/57a367b18e16fdf3ddf7adfb1ea46df4a02531da.png[/img]
[i]You may notice that at 19:00 it is slightly darker than 12:00[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999521/0b86fabe72c917968c2b3c988a00c7131ad2e290.png[/img]

Last but not least, if you are new to the game and you are lost, I suggest the Tutorial Mode, as it teaches you the very basics.


Enjoy the update!

notes.title: SAVE UPDATE
notes.content:
In this major update, Blue Land has received new features, with the main one being saving and loading. Also, the update includes:
-Improved UI
-Improved Crafting
-Balancing to damage
-Other small bug fixes

With the saving and loading, you are now able to save your progress in the pause menu, opened with the Escape key. The player stats then get stored first locally and if you are connected to WiFi and Steam, to the Steam servers as well! 

The update was suggested to me by a player of this game. If you have any suggestions for Blue Land, feel free to write about them in the community tab! I try my best to take all of your suggestions into account and use them to improve Blue Land!

Enjoy the update!
